summary: 5/6 claims fully verified. 1 claim partially verified with documentation inconsistency discovered. No critical runtime defects remain.

activation_addition.evidence: Real safetensors artifacts (5 files), load_nram_artifacts() loads 3 vectors + 2 conceptors, runtime populated correctly

conceptor_steering.evidence: Real conceptor artifacts with basis_vectors and singular_values, load correctly into conceptor_runtime

dexperts.evidence: Source code honestly marked NOT_IMPLEMENTED with VRAM explanation, but API capabilities endpoint misleadingly reports state=CONFIGURED, runtime_wired=True

defect.description: API capabilities endpoint claims dexperts state=CONFIGURED, runtime_wired=True, contradicting source NOT_IMPLEMENTED status

branch_tournament.evidence: Uses httpx.Client to call /v1/completions, no placeholder text, proper branch variation (seed, temperature), real scoring function

request_isolation.evidence: contextvars.ContextVar properly used (not threading.local), runtime async isolation test confirms no cross-contamination between concurrent tasks

coherence_floor.evidence: Trigram repetition ratio implemented at processor.py:918, feedback loop reduces positive_bias when coherence < floor, telemetry events emitted, runtime tests confirm correct behavior (unique=1.0, repeated=0.125)

defects_found.issue: API capabilities endpoint at api/routes.py:845-850 reports dexperts state=CONFIGURED, runtime_wired=True, contradicting source code NOT_IMPLEMENTED status
defects_found.impact: API clients may believe DExperts is functional when it is not
defects_found.recommendation: Update api/routes.py to report state=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, runtime_wired=False

next_step: Phase R3 Release Gate - verify R2-001 fix and perform end-to-end runtime verification with Docker container

release_readiness.recommendation: Fix R2-001 before release, but not a blocker for Phase R3
